items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Yeah, Albert was in the band playing bass.

ctx.x: Yeah, it's been... I got him. Limon Dauphin. Limon Dauphin. Dauphin, yeah.
Oh. Creole brother. I never heard of him before. No. Who else was there? Albert Litty was in the band?
Yeah, Albert was in the band playing bass.
